## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: NPB Stage 分类 + Tier 分层主逻辑

```sql
WITH stage_t AS (
    SELECT
        grass_region,
        item_id,
        CASE
            WHEN create_day_cnt <= 20 AND platform_order_acc = 0 THEN 1
            WHEN create_day_cnt <= 20
                 AND platform_order_acc >= 1
                 AND platform_order_acc <= 20 THEN 2
            ELSE 0
        END AS npb_stage,
        platform_impression_acc,
        platform_click_acc,
        platform_order_avg AS ado,
        CASE
            WHEN platform_click_acc IS NULL
                OR platform_impression_acc IS NULL
                OR platform_impression_acc <= 0 THEN 0.
            ELSE CAST(platform_click_acc AS DOUBLE)
                 / CAST(platform_impression_acc AS DOUBLE)
        END AS ctr
    FROM mp_paidads.ads_simple_roi2_npb_item_hi__reg_s0_live
    WHERE {condition}  -- (grass_region='XX' AND grass_date='YY' AND h=N) OR ...
),

state_2_threshold AS (
    SELECT
        stage_t.grass_region,
        approx_percentile(ado, 0.7) AS tier1_thres,
        approx_percentile(ado, 0.4) AS tier2_thres
    FROM stage_t
    JOIN ads_t
      ON stage_t.grass_region = ads_t.grass_region
     AND stage_t.item_id = ads_t.item_id
     AND stage_t.npb_stage = 2
    GROUP BY 1
),

state_add_tier_t AS (
    SELECT
        a.grass_region,
        item_id,
        npb_stage,
        CASE
            WHEN (npb_stage = 1 AND platform_impression_acc <= 200)
                OR (npb_stage = 2 AND ado >= tier1_thres) THEN 1
            WHEN (npb_stage = 1
                  AND platform_impression_acc > 200
                  AND ctr > 0.02)
                OR (npb_stage = 2
                    AND tier2_thres <= ado
                    AND ado < tier1_thres) THEN 2
            WHEN (npb_stage = 1 OR npb_stage = 2) THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END AS npb_tier
    FROM stage_t a
    LEFT JOIN state_2_threshold b
      ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region
)

SELECT
    grass_region || '_' || item_id AS key,
    npb_stage,
    npb_tier
FROM state_add_tier_t
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
```
